name: United Kingdom

name: Brazil
notes: The EU–Brazil visa waiver agreement for ordinary passports keeps the pre-2013 definition ('3 months during a 6-month period following the date of first entry') per the EC short-stay calculator manual — the standard rolling 90/180 calculator is not recommended for Brazilian ordinary-passport holders.

name: China
notes: Listed in Annex I, Section 1 (States) as a country whose nationals must hold a Schengen (Type C) visa. No footnote or partial exemption is attached to the 'China' entry itself (the People's Republic of China is on Annex I; only the Special Administrative Regions Hong Kong and Macao are separately listed on Annex II as visa-exempt, which does not extend to PRC ordinary passports).
